same.title: Always the same puzzles
same.text: Your set has {n} puzzles. Each timed run starts over from the first: you review the same motifs until you recognize them at a glance.

oneTry.title: One try only
oneTry.text: One mistake, and the solution appears: remember it, the puzzle will come back.

grows.title: A set that grows
grows.text: When a run gets through all the puzzles, the set grows with new puzzles of the same level.

custom.title: Tailor-made
custom.text: Don't like a puzzle? Replace it: another one of the same level takes its place.

same.title: Always the same puzzles
same.shuffled: A cycle means playing the set's {n} puzzles once each, in an order shuffled every cycle.
same.ordered: A cycle means playing the set's {n} puzzles once each, always in the same order.

faster.title: Faster and faster
faster.text: {n} cycles, each shorter than the previous one: {days}. Between two cycles, {rest}.

oneTry.title: One try only
oneTry.text: One mistake, and the solution appears: the puzzle counts as missed for this cycle. Remember the motif, it will come back.

deadline.title: The deadline matters
deadline.text: A cycle not finished in time is lost and starts over with the same time limit (“attempt 2”). Deadlines fall at the end of the day.

goal.title: The goal
goal.text: Gain accuracy and speed on the same motifs, until you play them by reflex in games.

custom.title: Tailor-made
custom.text: Don't like a puzzle? Replace it: another one of the same level takes its place, without changing the deadlines.

pace.lastDay: Last day: {puzzles} still to go today.
pace.left: {puzzles} and {days} days left: about {perDay} per day.

cycleCard.runHere: A timed run is in progress on this set.
cycleCard.runLightHint: Each run starts over from the first puzzle. The set grows when you get through it.
cycleCard.runClassicHint: The run moves the current cycle forward, deadline included.
cycleCard.pausedHint: Deadlines are pushed back by the length of the pause when you resume.

puzzles.label: Puzzles in the set ({n})
puzzles.caption: Replace the ones you don't like: a tailor-made set
puzzles.title: Puzzle {rating}

list.title: Woodpecker
list.oneByMode: Only one set in progress per mode (classic and light): finish or abandon one of them.
list.lead: Solve the same set of puzzles again and again to anchor the motifs: in shorter and shorter cycles (classic), or in timed runs (light).

new.title: New Woodpecker set
new.lightHint: Timed runs, no deadlines: each run starts over from the first puzzle and the set grows when you get through it. It starts at 100 puzzles.
new.classicHint: Shorter and shorter cycles, each with a deadline.
new.name: Name
new.alreadyLight: You already have an active or paused light set: finish or abandon it first.
new.alreadyClassic: You already have an active or paused classic set: finish or abandon it first.
new.invalid: Invalid settings, or not enough puzzles for these criteria: widen the range or the themes.

set.noGrowth: Not yet: the set grows when a run gets through it.
set.stubbornHintLight: Failed in at least two runs. Replayable freely (not counted).
set.stubbornHintClassic: Failed in at least two cycles. Replayable freely (not counted).
set.impossible: Action impossible in the set's current state.

play.cycleOver: This cycle is complete or lost: reload the set.

blocked.run: A timed run is in progress on this set.
blocked.light: This set is played in timed runs.
blocked.notNow: This set cannot be played right now.
